title: Sign Up for Global MapleStory Classic World Closed Online Test #2
original_title: Sign Up for Global MapleStory Classic World Closed Online Test #2
author: Global MapleStory
summary: The official campaign page records Global MapleStory Classic World Closed Online Test #2, with applications through July 29 and the test scheduled for August 4-12, 2026.

images.alt: Global MapleStory Classic World Closed Online Test #2

sections.title: Key dates
items: Closed Online Test #2 is scheduled for August 4-12, 2026.
Selected players receive access instructions through the email registered to their Nexon account.

sections.title: What's new in test #2
items: The preview adds 3rd Job Advancement and the Ossyria areas Orbis and El Nath.
macOS support and controller support with customizable layouts are included.
The test build adds more language options and incorporates feedback from the first test.

sections.title: Participation rules
items: Everyone must submit a new application, including players who participated in the first closed test.
Test content, balance, Cash Shop features, and other systems are not final.
Characters and progress will be wiped after the test ends.

notes: Reclassified as an event on 2026-07-27 after verifying the registration and test dates against Nexon's official news and campaign pages. The prior structured record is retained in snapshots.
event_name: Global MapleStory Classic World Closed Online Test #2
eligibility: Players selected after submitting the official test application
requirements: Submit a new application, including if selected for the first closed test.
Use the access instructions sent to the email registered to the selected Nexon account.
participation_steps: Submit the official application by July 29.
Check the registered Nexon Account email for selection and access instructions.
Install the supported test client and participate August 4-12.
